note: Input for scripts/build-hero-outfits.py. One Sidekick preset per hero becomes a six-slot armor set; `set` prefixes the item ids and file names. Change `preset` to any of the pack's six (see .tmp-outfits/previews after --previews) and rebuild. `extras` add more items from the same pack (explicit part names, usually from other presets, rendered with that preset's palette); an extra whose id is `<set>-<slot>` fills an empty slot and becomes the default.

descriptions.head: A deep hood cut for the forest paths; it keeps the rain and the archers' glare off.
descriptions.chest: Layered leather over a linen shirt, with a quiver strapped across the back.
descriptions.shoulders: Light leaf-plate mantles that never catch a bowstring.
descriptions.hands: Supple bracers worn smooth by the draw.
descriptions.legs: Leggings stitched for long marches and quiet steps.
descriptions.boots: Soft-soled boots for moving where nobody hears you.

extras.name: Bramble Circlet
extras.description: Living briar twisted into a crown; the leaves are still green.

extras.name: Stag Mask
extras.description: A stag's face carved in dark wood, antlers and all. The hunt looks back.

descriptions.head: A closed helm crowned with gilded antlers. The forest's answer to plate.
descriptions.chest: Gold-chased elven plate shaped like layered leaves.
descriptions.shoulders: Leaf-plate pauldrons that curl up like young ferns.
descriptions.hands: Fitted gauntlets in gold and bone.
descriptions.legs: Plated leggings with a hanging leaf skirt.
descriptions.boots: Gilded boots that somehow make no sound.

descriptions.head: A hood dyed the blue of the hour after sunset.
descriptions.chest: Dark blue leathers with gold thread at every seam.
descriptions.shoulders: Small gilt pauldrons over a night-blue mantle.
descriptions.hands: Blue-black bracers laced tight for the draw.
descriptions.legs: Dark leggings for moving through moonless woods.
descriptions.boots: Soft boots, dyed to vanish in shadow.

descriptions.head: A tall hat that has seen more storms than its wearer admits to.
descriptions.chest: A long robe worked with sigils, with a satchel of components slung behind.
descriptions.shoulders: Weighted pauldrons that keep the sleeves from the casting hand.
descriptions.hands: Gloves cut back at the fingers so nothing dulls the spell.
descriptions.boots: Sturdy boots; sorcerers still walk everywhere.

extras.name: Sorcerer's Pauldrons
extras.description: Weighted pauldrons that keep the sleeves from the casting hand.

extras.name: Familiar Perches
extras.description: Two carved familiars ride the shoulders and watch what the caster cannot.

extras.name: Spectral Grasp
extras.description: Conjured hands that never quite let go of the shoulders.

extras.name: Toad Familiar
extras.description: A toad in a very small hat, riding the off shoulder. It has opinions about your spells.

descriptions.head: A horned bone mask that the wearer swears is not their own skull.
descriptions.chest: Dark teal robes worked with a ribcage of bone.
descriptions.shoulders: Skull-and-bone pauldrons with a green glow in the sockets.
descriptions.hands: Gloves with bone plates over the knuckles.
descriptions.boots: Iron-toed boots for the crypt floor.

descriptions.head: A deep green hood with a curl of living wood.
descriptions.chest: Moss-green robes with a satchel of roots and vials.
descriptions.shoulders: Leaf and bark laid over the shoulders.
descriptions.hands: Fingerless gloves stained by a hundred herbs.
descriptions.legs: Layered green skirts over travel breeches.
descriptions.boots: Mud-brown boots that have never been dry.

descriptions.head: A closed helm worked into a roaring lion. The visor is the jaw.
descriptions.chest: White plate over gold trim, the lion's head hammered across the breast.
descriptions.shoulders: Broad gilt pauldrons, each with a mane of steel.
descriptions.hands: Articulated gauntlets polished until they show the torches.
descriptions.legs: Skirted plate over mail, cut for the long march.
descriptions.boots: Heavy sabatons that ring on the flagstones.

descriptions.head: A blackened helm with a slit visor and nothing behind it you'd want to meet.
descriptions.chest: Dark plate, dented and re-forged more than once.
descriptions.shoulders: A wolf pelt thrown over the pauldrons against the cold of the deep halls.
descriptions.hands: Black steel gauntlets with the knuckles filed to points.
descriptions.legs: Layered dark plate over riding leathers.
descriptions.boots: Iron-shod boots that have kicked in a few doors.

descriptions.head: A tall spired helm, the kind seen across a battlefield.
descriptions.chest: Grey plate under a red tabard, the cross long faded.
descriptions.shoulders: Plain steel pauldrons; the crusader spends on the sword.
descriptions.hands: Mail-backed gauntlets for a long grip.
descriptions.legs: A red tabard split over plate greaves.
descriptions.boots: Steel sabatons scuffed white at the toes.

extras.name: Sovereign Crown
extras.description: A gold crown over a mail coif. Someone in the dungeon used to be somebody.

extras.name: Plumed Bascinet
extras.description: A visored bascinet with a blue plume, for the knight who wants to be seen.

extras.name: Mail Hood
extras.description: A mail coif under a hood. Quiet, warm and stops a glancing blow.

descriptions.head: A riveted helm with two horns, because a helm without horns is a bucket.
descriptions.chest: Boiled hide over a wool tunic, with a knife and a horn on the belt.
descriptions.hands: Wrapped leather bracers, worn thin at the axe hand.
descriptions.boots: Fur-topped boots for the frozen shore.

descriptions.head: A great helm crowned with antlers. The hall goes quiet when it enters.
descriptions.chest: Scale armour over a green tunic, the jarl's own.
descriptions.shoulders: A wolf's pelt across the shoulders, head and all.
descriptions.hands: Riveted bracers with a ring of gold at each wrist.
descriptions.boots: Heavy boots bound in fur and iron.

descriptions.head: A grim iron helm with a raven riding on it, cawing at the wrong moments.
descriptions.chest: A dark red war coat under a mail collar.
descriptions.shoulders: Studded pauldrons with a raven's roost on the left.
descriptions.hands: Black leather bracers with an iron cuff.
descriptions.legs: Dark breeches with a coin purse that never stays full.
descriptions.boots: Boots wrapped in fur against the sea spray.

extras.name: Crested Helm
extras.description: A nasal helm with a bronze crest. Less horn, more head.
